task_instance: Scaffold a new M365 Copilot declarative agent project using the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit (ATK) CLI, per the skill's Scaffolding Workflow, and verify the resulting manifest/appPackage are well-formed.
evidence: Confirmed ATK CLI installable/runnable via `npx -y --package @microsoft/m365agentstoolkit-cli atk --version` -> 1.1.17. Ran `atk new -c declarative-agent -n testagent -i false` which created a full project at ./testagent: appPackage/declarativeAgent.json, appPackage/manifest.json, appPackage/instruction.txt, appPackage/color.png, appPackage/outline.png, env/.env.dev, env/.env.local, m365agents.yml, m365agents.local.yml, evals/prompts.json. Verified appPackage/declarativeAgent.json and appPackage/manifest.json both parse as valid JSON (python3 json.load succeeded for both) and declarativeAgent.json matches the v1.8 schema shape described in the skill's references (version, name, description, instructions referencing instruction.txt via $[file(...)]). This exercises the skill's core stated deliverable ('scaffold an agent' / create a declarative agent project). Deployment (`atk provision`) was not attempted since it requires a real Microsoft 365 tenant login/account (needs_credentials_or_account), which is out of scope per the sandbox's safety rules, but scaffolding and manifest generation/validation -- the create/build deliverable -- was fully produced and verified.
